# Songa Travel & Tours

> Authentic African safaris, road trips, and hiking adventures. Curated tours across Kenya and East Africa with transparent pricing in KES.

Songa Travel & Tours is a Kenyan tour operator offering guided safaris, scenic road trips, and hiking expeditions. Travelers can browse upcoming departures, book online with deposit-based payments, manage trips from a personal dashboard, and join WhatsApp groups for each departure.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured destinations, trending tours, and upcoming departures.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Browse and filter all available tours by destination, category, price, and date.
- [Road Trips](/road-trips): Curated self-drive and guided road trip experiences across East Africa.
- [About](/about): Our story, mission, and what makes Songa different.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch via email, phone, or WhatsApp.

## Account

- [Sign in or sign up](/auth): Create an account or log in to book and manage trips.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): View upcoming, completed, and cancelled bookings (requires login).

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How we handle your personal data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Booking and usage terms.
- [Refund Policy](/refund): Cancellation and refund rules.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full machine-readable list of public pages.
